build_truncated_svd: build a TruncatedSVD transformer to perform dimensionality reduction on sparse term count or TF-IDF matrices
fit_transform_svd: fit and transform sparse matrix data using TruncatedSVD with randomized SVD algorithm and 5 components
transform_new_data: transform new sparse matrix data using a fitted TruncatedSVD model to reduce dimensionality
inverse_transform_svd: inverse transform reduced-dimensional data back to the original feature space using TruncatedSVD components
fit_svd_model: fit a TruncatedSVD model with ARPACK algorithm and specified tolerance on training sparse matrix data
